assets.title: Bakery Display Corner
assets.description: Original soft low-poly baking display combining open vaulted oven and separately plated crescent pastry. Editable source components with actual structural connections.

assets.title: Warm Rolled Croissant
assets.description: Original static low-poly croissant with a continuous plump dough body, dominant central rolled sheet, progressively smaller side shoulders and long tapered crescent tips. Three closed upper dough layers genuinely attach to the body; the central narrowing sheet wraps down the inner arc and ends beneath the pastry. Separate serving plate. Same asset ID visual redesign v2, with changed proportions and presentation plate size; not a new unique type. Editable source and static GLB components; no cooking or dough simulation.

assets.title: Open Vaulted Baking Oven
assets.description: Original thick arch-shell oven with genuinely open front chamber, closed rear wall, hearth and plinth. Static visual module; no thermal, fire or cooking simulation. Distinct from the closed two-burner stove.

assets.title: Scored Round Bakery Loaf
assets.description: Original static low-poly round bread loaf with a continuous plump dome, flat resting underside and two separate diagonal shallow score openings. Warm baked crust and restrained lighter score interiors use solid materials without textures. Uniform top surface distribution avoids a polar fan pinch. Editable source and closed static GLB food mesh; no cooking or food performance simulation.

assets.title: Long Scored Bakery Loaf
assets.description: Original static low-poly baguette with a continuous long plump loaf, tapered rounded ends, flat underside and four independent oblique shallow score openings. Warm crust and restrained lighter score interiors use solid materials. Editable closed food mesh; no cooking or food performance simulation.

assets.title: Long Wooden Baking Peel
assets.description: Original static low-poly baking peel with a thin broad chamfered blade and long tapered eight-sided wooden handle. Two independently closed editable source components have a real embedded attachment. Intended static oven-hearth presentation is tested separately with the existing oven and round loaf; no dynamic insertion, heat, load or cooking simulation.

assets.title: Open Three-Tier Bakery Cooling Rack
assets.description: Original static low-poly open wooden bakery rack with three slatted shelves, four uprights and rear diagonal bracing. The front remains open for visual food access. Closed editable components with genuine structural attachment paths; no load rating, food-safety certification or thermal simulation.

assets.title: Two-Tier Countertop Bakery Display Case
assets.description: Original static low-poly two-tier countertop bakery display enclosure. Warm frame and shelf nodes support individually closed thin front, side and top guards; the inclined customer-facing guard and open rear replenishment side are distinct. It reuses an existing worktable rather than duplicating a cabinet base. Real 4 mm protective panels use glTF transmission and IOR materials. Separate tray placements and unchanged food clearance are checked in fixed poses. Selected physical glass uses transmission 1, IOR 1.45 and roughness 0.035. CPU preview images retain visible sampling grain; real-time WebGL transparency and depth ordering remain unverified in the available environment. No moving door, food-safety, load, thermal or continuous tray-removal certification.

assets.title: Shared Shallow Baking Tray
assets.description: Original static low-poly formed-metal baking tray with one continuous closed shallow basin, 3 mm bottom and 2 mm rim. Overall 0.60 by 0.32 by 0.025 m; inner floor approximately 0.58 by 0.30 m with clipped corners. Actual frozen round loaf and baguette each fit in separate static placements; documented oven hearth and cooling-rack slat contact areas are independently checked. No food resizing, continuous oven insertion, thermal behavior, load rating or food-safety certification.
